gates: Every case must return valid material fields and passing local grain checks
Default recipe source and legacy velocity/bed/lithology/surface/basement arrays must match frozen native engine exactly
Tiled and assembled logical content reproducible
Closed-library synthetic truth must receive a maximal likelihood; zero-likelihood candidates remain explicit
diagnosticOnly: Material refinement trends across complex histories, including every regression; no universal convergence threshold inferred
